candidates.change_summary: Replace the accumulation `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued;` with an assignment `imBalances[to] = creditsIssued;` so prior balances are wiped instead of increased.
Delete the `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued;` statement so deposits never update the recipient's balance.
Credit the caller instead of the designated recipient: `imBalances[msg.sender] += creditsIssued;`.
Remove the `nonReentrant` modifier from supplyTokenTo, allowing reentrant calls that can alter imBalances state during the call sequence.

Set the guard status to _NOT_ENTERED instead of _ENTERED in _nonReentrantBefore, effectively disabling the reentrancy protection so nested supplyTokenTo calls succeed and update imBalances unexpectedly.
